reference.model: CAM-SIMA (ESCOMP/CAM-SIMA, CIME FPHYStest) with ESCOMP/atmospheric_physics and NCAR/ccpp-framework
reference.provenance: the original Fortran program: same staged source, same build flags, same benchmark inputs and node class; run by the same kit as the candidate

environment.machine: NCAR Derecho CPU nodes, PBS, CIME machine derecho
environment.compiler: GNU Fortran 14.3.0 (CIME derecho_gnu, module gcc/14.3.0), the case's flags plus -ffp-contract=off

rules.dump_tool: numpy (digest_camsima.py's reader of the netCDF 64-bit offset format, checked value by value against ncdump -p 9,17 by check_reader.py; NCO is not on Derecho's default module path)
rules.dump_format: %+.17g: every numeric variable (byte/short/int/float/double) in sorted name order, a line with the name, then one line per value '%+.17g' (C order, all records); md5 of the text. The char variables date_written/time_written (wall-clock stamps) and all attributes are not dumped

rules.dump_tool: md5 of the text after the kit's TestStatus masks (compare_case.py at 783ef4bb)
rules.dump_format: compare_case.py TestStatus rules, in order, per line: re.sub(r' time=\S+', ''); re.sub(r'\S+\.(pic|insitu\S*)\b', '<case>'); the test name (the reference case dir name without its test-id) -> '<test>'; then md5 of the lines joined by '\n'

rules.dump_tool: md5 of the text after the kit's atm.log masks (compare_case.py at 783ef4bb)
rules.dump_format: compare_case.py atm.log rules: gunzip; splitlines; drop every line where re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}|memory|Memory|highwater|seconds|sec/|wall|Wall|time|Time|pid|PID|hostname)') matches (dates, clock times, timers, memory, pids, host names); the run's CASE (test name + test-id) -> '<case>'; then md5 of the lines joined by '\n'

rules.note: wall time of the original vs the translated run (CIME TestStatus RUN time=, whole seconds); reported, never gates

outputs.location: derecho:$DERECHO_SCRATCH/recast-cand/cases/<test>.<test-id> (the translated program's CIME case; the original's is <test>.pic); per case in report.txt
outputs.retention: cluster scratch, rolling purge (runs of 2026-10-04/05); digests kept in report.txt

notes: wave24 in-situ acceptance: the project's own benchmark run by the original Fortran program and by the translated program (the benchmark's Fortran main with the benchmark-reached subprograms in NumPy through f2py, RecastEngine-Pro 783ef4bb, tag wave24-accepted), in the same environment; every compared output file digested on the cluster from the accepted runs (no re-run). Security gate not run (NOT_RUN). outputs.location and outputs.files are filled from the per-case digests (make_manifest fingerprints only local CAM-named files). Filed in PR #12 and assembled again at Val-Track 01b0f3a, where it replaces the reconstructed record the wave24 backfill filed here (invariant 8's upgrade).
